objective: Read the Verdant Note and speak to Gart Mistrunner in Camp Narache.

description: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, <name>. I believe she was sent by the druid trainer Gart. If this note is from Gart, I wouldn't take long in reading its contents.
progress: You have arrived. This is good. Our ancestors' spirits have become restless throughout Mulgore and beyond, but I cannot tell why. It will forever be your duty to learn to listen to nature's spirits, and act as their avatar. Be mindful of that.
completion: Though we share a common bond, do not expect much welcome from the night elves. Their pride still limits their sight, but that is none of our concern. The teachings of the Earthmother are all you must concern yourself with, and I will teach you what I know as you grow in wisdom.
Return to me often, <name>. You will find that the Earthmother grants incredible abilities to those who are most dedicated.
